question: In August 2020, who was promoted to ICC’s international panel of umpires?
solution:
The correct answer is __**KN Ananthapadmanabhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Following the promotion of compatriot Nitin Menon to the elite panel, **India's KN Ananthapadmanabhan** has been added to the ICC's international panel of umpires.
 
• In the international panel, the former Kerala spinner joins other Indians C Shamshuddin, Anil Chaudhary, and Virender Sharma, and is now qualified to officiate in ODI and T20 internationals, as well as an umpire in the youth World Cup.
 
• Ananthapadmanabhan took 344 and 87 wickets in 105 First-Class and 54 List A games for Kerala, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Sundaram Ravi is an Indian cricket umpire who served on the International Cricket Council's Elite Panel of Umpires from 2015 to 2019.
 
• Anil Chaudhary is a cricket umpire from India. On October 10, 2013, he played in his maiden Twenty20 International (T20I) between India and Australia.
 
• Kumar Dharmasena, also known as Deshabandu Handunnettige Deepthi Priyantha Kumar Dharmasena, is a Sri Lankan cricket umpire and former international cricketer who represented Sri Lanka in Tests and ODIs.
